name: Moving Forward
overview: Scripture calls believers to advance with steadfast faith, trusting in the Lord's guidance rather than their own understanding, as seen in Proverbs 3:5 and Psalms 32:8. God commands His people to move forward from places of stagnation or waiting, exemplified by His instruction to Israel to go forward in Exodus 14:15 and Deuteronomy 1:6. The righteous are encouraged to persevere and grow stronger in their walk, keeping their focus straight ahead, as Proverbs 4:25 and Job 17:9 affirm.
